senses.gloss: लक् vt. 10U (pres. लाकयति-ते) 1. To obtain; 2. to taste.
लक n. 1. The forehead; 2. an ear of wild rice.
लकच (I) n. A kind of bread-fruit tree.
लकच (I) n. A kind of bread-fruit tree.
लकुच (II) n. The fruit of this tree.
लकुट m. A club.
लक्तक m. 1. Lac; 2. a tattered cloth.
लक्तिका f. A lizard.
लक्ष् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. लक्षते) To perceive, to apprehend, to see, to observe.

लक्ष् (II) vt. 10U (pp. लक्षित; pres. लक्षयति-ते) 1. To mark, to denote, to characterise, to indicate, बीजलक्षणलक्षिता M.ix.35; 2. to signify or mean secondarily, अत्र गोशब्दः वाहीकार्थं लक्षयति S.D.ii.; 3. to consider, to regard, to think; 4. to perceive, to observe, योगप्रभावो न च लक्ष्यते ते R.xvi.7, ix.72.With आ-, to observe, to notice, to perceive, शोच्या च प्रियदर्शना च मदनक्लिष्टेयमालक्ष्यते Sak.iii., R.xv.18.With उप-, 1. to mark, to characterise, Kull. on M.ii.170; 2. to include or to denote secondarily, नक्षत्रशब्देन ज्योतिःशास्त्रमुपलक्ष्यते Kull. on M.iii.162; 3. to perceive, to observe; 4. to think, to consider, to regard as.With वि-, 1. to see, to observe; 2. to become bewildered or contused; 3. to distinguish, to characterise.With सम्-, 1. to see, to perceive, to observe; 2. to distinguish; 3. to test, to prove, हेम्नः संलक्ष्यते ह्यग्नौ विशुद्धिः श्यामिकापि वा R.i.10; 4. to learn, to understand, to know, संलक्ष्यते न च्छिदुरोपि हारः R.xvi.62.
लक्ष (I) m.n. 1. One hundred thousand, एकोनत्रिंशल्लक्षानि तथा नव शतानि च Yaj.iii.101, त्रयो लक्षास्तु विज्ञेयाः 102.
लक्ष (II) n. 1. A mark, a token; 2. a target, a butt; 3. pretence, show, fraud.

लाक्षा f. 1. A kind of red dye; (it is obtained from the cochineal insect and from the resin of particular trees; it was largely used as an article of decoration by women, निष्ठ्यूतश्चरणोपभोगसुलभो लाक्षारसः केनचित् Sak.iv., Kir.v.23); 2. the insect which products red dye.
लक्ष-अधीश m. a person possessing a lāc.
लक्ष-शस् ind. by hundreds of thousands.
लक्षक (I) a. (f. का) Expressing secondarily, indicating indirectly.
लक्षक (II) n. One hundred thousand.
लक्षक (I) a. (f. का) Expressing secondarily, indicating indirectly.

लक्षण (I) n. 1. A mark, a sign, token, a characteristic, an indication (पुरुषलक्षण ‘the organ of virility’), अव्याक्षेपो भविष्यंत्याः कार्यसिद्धेर्हि लक्षणम् R.x.6, दृष्टशुभगर्भलक्षणा R.xix.55, Megh.ii.17; 2. an attribute, a quality; 3. an accurate definition (in phil.); 4. a mark indicative of good or bad fortune, क्व तद्विधस्त्वं क्व च पुण्यलक्षणा K.S.v.73, M.xi.53; 5. a symptom of disease; 6. a fixed rate, M.viii.406; 7. designation, appellation, तेषां दिक्षु प्रथितविदिशालक्षणां राजधानीम् Megh.i.24; 8. subject, head, topic; 9. cause, occasion; 10. effect, operation; 11. excellence, qualification, virtue, merit, ककुत्स्थ इत्याहितलक्षणोऽभूत् R.vi.71; 12. an auspicious mark on the body of a person; (they are 32 in number).
लक्षण (II) m. the Indian crane.
लक्षणा f. 1. Aim, object; 2. a goose; 3. indirect or secondary application of a word, (मुख्यार्थबाधे तद्योगे रूढितोऽथ प्रयोजनात् । अन्योऽर्थो लक्ष्यते यत्सा लक्षणारोपिता क्रिया K.Pr.ii.).
लक्षण-अन्वित a. endowed with good marks.
लक्षण-ज्ञ a. able to interpret marks or signs.
लक्षण-लक्षणा f. the same as जहल्लक्षणा q.v.
लक्षण-सन्निपात m. branding, stigmatizing.
लक्षण्य a. (f. ण्या) 1. Defined; 2. marked, characterized; 3. aimed at; 4. indicated, meant indirectly; 5. discovered, beheld, seen; 6. inquired into, examined, (pp. of लक्ष् q.v.).
लक्षण्य a. (f. ण्या) 1. Defined; 2. marked, characterized; 3. aimed at; 4. indicated, meant indirectly; 5. discovered, beheld, seen; 6. inquired into, examined, (pp. of लक्ष् q.v.).
लाक्षण्य a. (f. ण्या) One who can explain or interpret signs.
लाक्षण्य a. (f. ण्या) One who can explain or interpret signs.
लक्ष्मण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Having good marks, possessed of lucky signs; 2. wealthy.
लक्ष्मण (II) m. 1. The Indian crane; 2. name of a son of Daśaratha. (See App. II.)
लक्ष्मण (III) n. 1. A name; 2. a sign, a mark, a token.
लक्ष्मण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Having good marks, possessed of lucky signs; 2. wealthy.
लक्ष्मणा f. A goose.
लक्ष्मण-प्रसू f. Sumitrā, the mother of Lakshmaṇa.
लक्ष्मन् (I) m. 1. The sārasa bird; 2. a name of Lakshmaṇa, son of Daśaratha.
लक्ष्मन् (II) n. 1. A mark, a characteristic, a sign, K.S.vii.43, R.xix.30; 2. a speck, a spot, मलिनमपि हिमांशोर्लक्ष्म लक्ष्मीं तनोति Sak.i.; 3. a definition.

लक्ष्मी f. 1. Name of the goddess of fortune and beauty regarded as the wife of Viṣṇu; she is said to have sprung from the ocean when churned by the gods and demons; 2. good fortune, good luck; 3. wealth, prosperity; 4. beauty, loveliness, charm, बालस्य लक्ष्मीं ग्लपयंतमिंदोः K.S.iii.49, मलिनमपि हिमांशोर्लक्ष्म लक्ष्मीं तनोति Sak.i.; 5. the wife of a hero; 6. royal power, dominion, तया मेने मनस्विन्या लक्ष्म्या च वसुधाधिपः R.i.32, xii.26; 7. splendour, lustre; 8. a pearl.
लक्ष्मी-ईश m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. the mango tree; 3. a prosperous man.
लक्ष्मी-कांत m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a king, विहाय लक्ष्मीपतिलक्ष्म कार्मुकम् Kir.i.44.
लक्ष्मी-गृह n. the red lotus-flower.
लक्ष्मी-ताल m. a kind of palm.
लक्ष्मी-नाथ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
लक्ष्मी-पति m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a king; 3. the betelnut tree; 4. the clove tree.
लक्ष्मी-पुत्र m. 1. a horse; 2. an epithet of Kāmadeva.
लक्ष्मी-पुष्प m. a ruby.
लक्ष्मी-पूजन n. the ceremony of worshipping Lakṣmī, performed at the conclusion of a Hindu marriage.
लक्ष्मी-पूजा f. worship of Lakṣmī on the last day of the month of Āśvina.
लक्ष्मी-फल m. the Bilva tree.
लक्ष्मी-रमण m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
लक्ष्मी-वत् a. 1. lucky, fortunate; 2. rich, wealthy; 3. beautiful, handsome.
लक्ष्मी-वसति f. the red lotus-flower.
लक्ष्मी-वार m. Thursday.
लक्ष्मी-वेष्ट m. turpentine.
लक्ष्मी-सख m. a favourite of Lakṣmī.
लक्ष्मी-सहज m. the moon.

लक्ष्य (I) a. (f. क्ष्या) 1. To be marked; 2. to be defined; 3. to be aimed at; 4. to be regarded as; 5. to be looked at, R.vi.11; 6. to be denoted indirectly; 7. to be known, to be traced, K.S.v.81; 8. recognizable by, (with an inst.), दूराल्लक्ष्यं सुरपतिधनुश्चारुणा तोरणेन Megh.ii.12, K.S.v.74, R.iv.5.

लक्ष्य (II) n. 1. A butt, a target, a mark aimed at, दृष्टलक्ष्यमिदः शराः R.i.61, K.S.iii.64; 2. one hundred thousand; 3. secondary meaning, one derived by Lakshaṇa (q.v.), K.Pr.ii.; 4. the thing defined, उपकारापकारौ हि लक्ष्यं लक्षणमेतयोः Sis.ii.37; 5. a sign, a token; 6. pretence, sham, किं लक्ष्यसुप्तमुत परमार्थसुप्तमिदं द्वयम् Mrich.iii., रोमांचलक्ष्येण स गात्रयष्टिं भित्वा निराक्रामदरालकेश्याः R.vi.81.

लक्ष्य (I) a. (f. क्ष्या) 1. To be marked; 2. to be defined; 3. to be aimed at; 4. to be regarded as; 5. to be looked at, R.vi.11; 6. to be denoted indirectly; 7. to be known, to be traced, K.S.v.81; 8. recognizable by, (with an inst.), दूराल्लक्ष्यं सुरपतिधनुश्चारुणा तोरणेन Megh.ii.12, K.S.v.74, R.iv.5.
लक्ष्य-क्रम a. having the order perceptible, (said of Dhvani in rhetorical works).
लक्ष्य-भेद m. the cleaving of a mark.
लक्ष्य-सुप्त a. pretending to be asleep, Mrich.iii.
लक्ष्य-हन् m. an arrow.
लाकुटिक m. The same as लागुडिक q.v.
लाक्षकी f. A name of Sītā.
लाक्षणिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Acquainted with signs; 2. indicatory, characteristic; 3. used in a secondary sense, स्याद्वाचको लाक्षणिकः शब्दोऽत्र व्यंजकस्त्रिधा K.Pr.ii.; 4. technical.
लाक्षणिक (II) m. A technical term.
लाक्षणिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Acquainted with signs; 2. indicatory, characteristic; 3. used in a secondary sense, स्याद्वाचको लाक्षणिकः शब्दोऽत्र व्यंजकस्त्रिधा K.Pr.ii.; 4. technical.
लाक्षा-तरु, -वृक्ष m. name of a tree, (butea frondosa).
लाक्षा-तरु, -वृक्ष m. name of a tree, (butea frondosa).
लाक्षा-प्रसाद, -प्रसाधन m. the red Lodhra tree.
लाक्षा-प्रसाद, -प्रसाधन m. the red Lodhra tree.
लाक्षिक a. (f. की) 1. Relating to lac; 2. relating to a lac.
लाक्षिक a. (f. की) 1. Relating to lac; 2. relating to a lac.
